newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends softer in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends softer in light trade.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended softer on Thursday at C$1.3769 (US$0.7262) from Wednesday's close of C$1.3764 in light trading ahead of U.S. economic data due out Friday.
* Traders said the U.S. non-farm payrolls report for May is expected to give some indication of inflationary pressure in the U.S. economy and the direction of interest rates.
Smaller-than-expected numbers would point to a slowdown in the U.S. economy, while higher numbers would help the U.S. Federal Reserve press for an interest rate hike to ward off inflation.
"Tomorrow's numbers are the best piece of information we'll have coming out since the election, and they should give the market an indication for near-term Fed policy," one trader said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar fell to 83.87 yen from Wednesday's close of 84.49 yen and eased to 1.2546 marks from 1.2552 marks.
